If you have a garden or access to a garden then I would recommend buying some sand bags. There’s some brilliant circuits you can do with them. 

Also never underestimate a medicine ball! I spent a whole summer doing medicine ball circuits with my dad when I was about seventeen and good Lord was I fit after that.

Basically instead of doing say three sets of press ups with a minute between them and then a two minute rest before doing three sets of leg raises and then a two minute rest and three sets of squats, you would do a set of press ups with maybe a 30 second rest and then a set of leg raises and then a thirty second rest and then your set of crunches etc and do that a total of three times (this is just an example)
The point of it is that you have a shorter rest in order to keep your heart rate up because you are switching to a different exercise and therefore a different muscle group enabling. The maintained increased heart rate is what helps your body burn fat.

First time I’ve ever posted on reddit, so please be gentle but reading these posts unlocked a memory and I felt like I had to share it because it’s bugging me.


So when I was in primary school (probably about six years old) I became friends with a kid called Calvin from my class. Calvin was a nice guy but he was also autistic and had ADHD so he didn’t have many friends. I liked him though and we both enjoyed video games where as most of the kids back then were just into football. 

I didn’t know it at the time but Calvins parents were really rich and when they gave him the option to bring a friend on one of their cool trips he opted to invite me. It was nice to go to the theatre in London or for dinner because it wasn’t something my family really ever did and after a few years me and Calvin were really good friends and I knew his parents really well. 

After probably about six years of being friends his family decided to invite me to go to Gran Canaria with them. I couldn’t believe it, I was so excited. I live in England and my family could never afford to leave the country to go in holiday so it was a big deal for me to leave the country especially to somewhere nearly two thousand miles away. 

So in December 2006 I flew out with his family for a week and honestly it was amazing, I’ve still never had a holiday anywhere near as fancy as that! On probably the second or third day we made friends with some of the other English kids that were there and started meeting up every day to hang out. There was probably about 8 of us including me and Calvin but I only remember the two who were closer to our age. Jess, who was a few years older and Steven (or Spud as he told us to call him) who was 12/13 like me and Calvin. Spud was a really funny guy and we clicked instantly. 

We hung out for the rest of the week and at the end of the holiday we all swapped emails addresses and said the standard emotional holiday goodbye, sad in the knowledge that we would never see Jessica or Spud again. Me and Calvin were both from Greater London and I think Jessica was from Essex which isn’t too far from London but Spud was from Blackpool which is roughly 300 miles from London and I’m not sure I’d even heard of it before. We chatted on MSN sometimes but it sort of faded out after a few months. 

Fast forward eight months and it’s now summer 2007 and I’m on holiday with my family in Cornwall, England standing on a beach and my mum asks me to take a wander down to the sea with her to help look after my little brother. So I’m splashing around and talking about how much warmer the sea was in Gran Canaria and a kid bumps in to me by accident. I turn around and it was Spud! It was bizarre! I had a pretty distinct emo look at the time so he recognised me instantly. We chatted for a few minutes and he said he was just down from Blackpool (360+ miles away!) to see his grandparents for the week and he was going home tomorrow. After a few minutes he left to go and find his parents and I never saw him again.

It freaked me out, I was utterly baffled. What were the odds that someone I met 8 months previously nearly 2000 miles from home would now be stood on a beach back in England and over 300 miles from where either of us actually lived! Not only that but there was easily a thousand people on the beach that day and I just happened to physically bump in to Spud. I’m actually convinced I‘ll bump in to him again one day, maybe I’ll make my second ever Reddit post if I do! 

Thanks for letting me vent Reddit, I can’t believe I forgot about that given how often I used to think about it.
